seo.title: About Our Kuala Lumpur Law Firm
seo.description: TAN, KONG & ASSOCIATES unites Kenny Tan's criminal defence practice with Kong Jiun Yuan's civil and corporate practice at Publika, Mont Kiara, Kuala Lumpur.

about.heroAlt: Partners discussing a matter in a Kuala Lumpur office
about.storyImageAlt: Statue of Lady Justice holding the scales
about.story: TAN, KONG & ASSOCIATES unites the criminal defence practice of Kenny Tan (formerly Tan Cheng Yee & Co) with the civil, corporate and dispute-resolution practice of Kong Jiun Yuan (Melvin) (formerly JY Kong Law Firm). Together we offer a full-service boutique firm from our office at Publika Solaris Dutamas, Mont Kiara.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.body: Honest advice even when it is difficult to hear.

dedication.title: Dedication
dedication.body: We stand by our clients every step of the way.

kenny.bio: Kenny Tan is a criminal defence lawyer with over a decade of experience. Since establishing his practice in 2020 he has defended more than 1,000 criminal cases, helping local and foreign clients secure release from detention or acquittal. He is known for practical, aggressive and strategic defence tactics — securing bail, negotiating police releases, and protecting fundamental rights in court.
kenny.focus: Criminal law, bail applications, police detention, foreign clients, civil litigation and family matters.

melvin.bio: Kong Jiun Yuan (Melvin) holds an LL.B. (Hons.) from Multimedia University (2013). He has practised banking litigation, debt recovery, personal injury and motor accident claims, and corporate commercial work — including share purchase and joint venture agreements. He has also advised a Vietnamese company as legal counsel in Ho Chi Minh City, collaborating with counsel across ASEAN and the United States.
melvin.focus: Debt recovery, shareholder & contractual disputes, corporate agreements, personal injury, family law and property transactions.

civil.body: Dispute resolution and courtroom advocacy for commercial and private civil claims, with a focus on practical outcomes.

debt.title: Debt recovery & fraud
debt.body: Swift action to protect cash flow and reputation — garnishee proceedings, execution, bankruptcy and winding-up advice.

corporate.title: Corporate & commercial
corporate.body: Shareholder disputes, contractual breaches, share purchase and joint venture agreements, and board-level counsel.

personal-injury.title: Personal injury & motor claims
personal-injury.body: Accident briefs, quantum assessment, insurance negotiations and trials for injury and motor vehicle claims.

family.title: Family law & mediation
family.body: Divorce, custody, maintenance and mediation — supportive representation for sensitive family matters.

property.title: Property & conveyancing
property.body: Due diligence, agreements and secure transactions for residential and commercial property purchases.

employment.title: Employment & industrial
employment.body: Unfair dismissal claims at the Industrial Court, employment advice and workplace dispute resolution.

careers.title: Careers
careers.subtitle: We believe in our people

seo.title: Careers & Pupillage
seo.description: Associate, pupillage, internship and paralegal opportunities at a boutique law firm in Publika, Mont Kiara, Kuala Lumpur, with hands-on partner mentorship.

careers.introBody: You have worked hard to get where you are. We are looking for bright candidates with strong academic skills, a passion for advocacy, and the readiness to assume responsibility early in their legal career — in a supportive boutique environment at Publika, Mont Kiara.

mentorship.title: Hands-on mentorship
mentorship.body: Work closely with partners on real files from day one — criminal defence, civil litigation and corporate matters.

growth.title: Early responsibility
growth.body: A boutique firm means meaningful work, courtroom exposure and clear pathways to grow your practice.

culture.title: Collegial culture
culture.body: A congenial environment with like-minded people who value integrity, clear communication and results.

associates.title: Lawyers / Associates
associates.body: We welcome applications from advocates & solicitors who thrive in dispute resolution and client-facing work. Strong written and oral advocacy skills are essential.

pupils.title: Pupils-in-Chambers
pupils.body: Pupillage with exposure across criminal defence and civil & commercial practice. We seek pupils with strong academics and a genuine interest in advocacy.

interns.title: Internships & attachments
interns.body: Short-term attachments for law students seeking practical insight into boutique litigation and conveyancing practice.

paralegals.title: Paralegals / litigation secretaries
paralegals.body: Support roles for organised, discreet professionals who keep files, diaries and client communications running smoothly.

careers.remunerationBody: We offer competitive packages commensurate with experience, plus a supportive environment for professional development. Details are discussed with shortlisted candidates.
careers.applyBody: To submit a résumé or request more information about employment opportunities, please email us. You may also book an appointment if you prefer a conversation first.
